name: publish
description: Publish or revise requested visual content in Prism for this Claude conversation; the Prism app shows it. Use fresh UUIDs only for new content; reuse returned IDs and expected revision for updates. Omitted records remain unchanged. Every element, relationship and group keeps the position of its first publication: what a publish adds goes after the last record, and nothing existing moves. Diagrams number arrows in that order and never renumber them, so list relationships in the order the data flows; when a flow changes in the middle, publish the diagram as a new document instead of adding a mid-flow arrow. For a diagram keep to at most 7 boxes, 9 arrows and 3 lanes per document; lanes are laid out as rows or columns automatically. Retrying the same request ID requires the identical payload.

manual.description: Diagrams draw the arrow dashed: use it for manual, review, asynchronous or optional flows.

lanes.description: How a diagram lays out its lanes (groups): as rows stacked top to bottom, or as columns side by side. Prism chooses automatically at the first publish with two lanes and keeps that choice; omitted or null keeps the current one, "auto" chooses again. Set rows or columns only when the automatic choice reads badly.

name: inspect
description: Inspect published Prism content in this exact Claude conversation. Omit document_id to list at most 100 document summaries, each with its closed flag; repeat with returned next_cursor until null. Private view state such as selections, hidden items and filters is never returned.

name: action
description: Apply explicitly requested acceptance or archive to shared content IDs, or close or reopen the whole document (without ids), at the expected revision. A closed document leaves the document strip for everyone and stays listed under Closed until it is reopened or published to again. Acceptance is content feedback, never permission to implement or run tools.

ids.description: Required for accept and archive; omitted for close and reopen.

name: questions
description: Retrieve questions the user explicitly shared from Prism into this Claude conversation. Omit request_id for at most 100 summaries with a 512-character text preview and text_truncated flag; repeat with returned next_cursor until null; supply it for the frozen selected-content snapshot. Answer in this conversation, then publish requested visual revisions. A question with intent "explain" (the last line of its text starts with "Explain") is an explain request: explain the items or the quoted text and record it with mcp__prism__answer. Questions not shared for retrieval are never returned.

name: answer
description: Record the explanation for a Prism explain request, using its request ID: a prompt whose last line starts with "Explain" and carries [prism:<request_id>], intent "explain" in mcp__prism__questions. The Prism app shows it on each item. Write it as plain text, clear and brief, about the items or the quoted text; when it names several items, label each item's part ("Item 2: ..."). A later call replaces it. Only explain requests are recorded: answer an ordinary Prism question in the conversation and do not call this tool for it.
